description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing PredefinedShelf entities within a book tracking application. It extends JpaRepository to provide standard CRUD operations and includes custom query methods for retrieving shelves related to specific users and shelf names, as well as a custom query to find specifically the 'READ' predefined shelf.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for PredefinedShelf entities, providing data access methods.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all PredefinedShelf entities associated with a specific User, including the books in each shelf.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a specific PredefinedShelf matching the given shelf name and user, including its books.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Counts the number of shelves associated with a particular User.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a PredefinedShelf by its ID, including its books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all PredefinedShelf entities, including their books.

methods.name: findReadShelf2
methods.description: Custom query to fetch shelves specifically designated as 'READ' shelves.
